description:
Prices a verified flood estimate (first call) and returns it (later calls).

    Returns the estimated annual premium, flood zone and what it means, whether lenders usually
    require flood insurance there, and a notice that must be shown with the price: the estimate
    comes from the flood carrier's test environment, is not an offer and cannot be bound online.
    To buy, call request_agent with the quote_id.
name: get_flood_quote
title: Get the flood insurance estimate
